name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global) + animation domain (sole reader is fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim) + descriptor palette_cycle_rgb_table accurately reflects the palette-cycling RGB-stream table data type. No Ghidra address residue. Live Ghidra symbol and src declaration already match byte-identically.
purpose: VGA palette-cycle RGB animation source for environment effects (water/lava/fire): the 16-frame sliding-window RGB stream that fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim scrolls through palette indices 0xE0..0xEF.
logic_summary: Flat read-only uint8 stream of 31 contiguous 3-byte RGB triples (93 bytes). Sole accessor fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim @ 0x4DFCC computes frame_idx(0..15)*3 (MOV AH,3 / MUL AH @ 0x4DFFD-0x4DFFF), LEAs the table base (0x4E001, DATA xref), adds the offset (ADD ESI,EAX @ 0x4E007), then loops 16 colors (MOV ECX,0x10 @ 0x4E009) emitting 3 LODSB bytes per color to the VGA DAC data port 0x3C9 (LODSB @ 0x4E019, READ xref). Each frame f reads the sliding 48-byte window [f*3 .. f*3+47]; max start 15*3=45, +48 -> last byte 92 -> exactly 93 bytes. Adjacent frames share 15 of 16 triples, producing a smooth scrolling palette animation. Components are 6-bit VGA values (0..0x3F).
element_semantics: One unsigned 8-bit VGA DAC color component (6-bit range 0..0x3F). Bytes are grouped as 31 consecutive RGB triples (R,G,B); they are consumed as an overlapping sliding window rather than as fixed per-frame rows. Index into the stream = frame_idx*3 + intra-frame byte position.
notes: Memory bytes @ 0x60003 (93B) verified byte-identical to the src initializer and to read_memory output. Sole reader confirmed via xrefs: DATA @ 0x4E001 (LEA base load) + READ @ 0x4E019 (LODSB); no writers -> const. Ghidra datatype already byte[93]. Ghidra plate was stale: it lived in PRE_COMMENT (legacy convention), used non-ASCII chars (em-dash, arrow, multiply, approx), cited the reader function entry as 0x4DFB6 (actual entry is 0x4DFCC; 0x4DFB6 is inside the preceding function), and carried a 'D5 audit' phase tag. Rewrote it into PLATE_COMMENT (canonical data-plate field per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism), ASCII-clean, correct entry 0x4DFCC, dropped the phase tag; cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT. src comment was already accurate/concise/ASCII and matches the verified behavior, so kept unchanged (no src edit). No name change this stage (name already compliant; rename not applicable).
